indications: Mild to severe unicompartmental knee osteoarthritis (medial or lateral)
measurement: Measure calf circumference 6 in. below mid-patella with leg in full extension. Standard Length is recommended for patients with a leg length greater than 85 cm (taller than approximately 5'4"). Do NOT self-diagnose your compartment -- X-ray or physician diagnosis determines whether you need a Medial or Lateral configuration. For assistance, visit our Perfect Fit Promise .
